## Design

### 2026-10-14 – I brainstormed some simple ideas because I am a beginner, but didn't want to make something too easy because I wanted to challenge myself. I saw the guide was a marble run, and thought if there were a

**3h**

I brainstormed some simple ideas because I am a beginner, but didn't want to make something too easy because I wanted to challenge myself. I saw the guide was a marble run, and thought if there were any other game type of things I could make. I looked for many things, and saw that Battleship might be a good one to try.

![Screenshot 2026-10-15 at 5.30.13 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/e5541eb57822d938b8d7ee51046508fd4694a20d4c3bc9c848c9f3cda761a4d1.png)

I didn't want to copy it, and wondered what I could do to make it unique. I just decided to start before I came up with variations. I made a simple square grid after seeing how the controls work.

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 122007](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/3644f2e9c24ba622a53810084e55a75470181ef938966eb26c8355f50f94f982.png)

I had fully defined the sketch, and then I added one text box, and Onshape started saying "sketch could not be solved." Since there were so many constraints, I wasn't able to even find anything that could be contradicting something else.

![Screenshot 2026-10-12 132640](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/80d740bc72733a5efeeccf8bfda19d19f20da6fc57ff24f9fb2bd19bce6bfde4.png)

I had to restart multiple times because of that, and then decided that I should just restart and use a hexagonal model for varying the design. So far, it is going very smoothly, but just in case, I will be extruding before adding new sketch elements so it is easier to keep track of my work.

### 2026-10-15 – I started with the hexagonal design with a flat-top hexagon for the base, and a pointy-top hexagon for the tiles (An interesting thing I had never observed before was that pointy-top hexagons tesselat

**4h**

I started with the hexagonal design with a flat-top hexagon for the base, and a pointy-top hexagon for the tiles (An interesting thing I had never observed before was that pointy-top hexagons tesselate into flat-top hexagons, and vice versa.) I linear-patterned them into a trapezoid shape, and did some math so that I could mirror that for the bottom.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/f572e7f70f567d41b7e8301781c8dce4067e6a94151615c949c15b31f5668e13.png)

I extruded that and the tiles and tried to balance the height so it's strong and not too bulky. (It's off center so that I can have coordinate numbers.)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/ef298431dcf277d16b6c6b803daebd5116bfb6e987cc6c8e8b556b70481b927a.png)

I then added numbers and guide-lines so that the players know which way the grid goes. It took a lot of time to adjust the numbers into good positions and have good sizes.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/df9efebebafdf9a7fd33c0fdb16879748e39db81d6611a67da8d9fed5908b0ab.png)

I extruded the numbers and revolved the guide-lines to make it look nice (The image below is zoomed and in diagonal view so that the extrude and revolves are visible).

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/0415836c2eda1c1106e048ab109c607e732657672feb8de815eb4a2196b71b5a.png)

### 2026-10-17 – Friday October 16:

**3h**

Friday October 16:

I started making the letter coordinates like the numbers, and it took a very long time to get good sizes and define everything. I changed some of the numbers too.

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 at 10.13.17 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/5073fe7b6d959091da6884095b0e5f5467171a2bf5f6b4025d39a13a951f5ccd.png)

I thought of maybe changing the coordinate system, but I looked online, and it seemed that what I was doing was the best method. I found an interesting article about hexagonal coordinates on redblobgames.com.

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 at 11.26.41 AM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/49839143ae4ae773ab40685e18c1401d60fa719f47814bf170b1db36f498ca1a.png)

I decided to stop working on it so I could duplicate it for both the top and bottom platforms. I then started working on pegs. I made the stick part taper a bit so it fits snugly, and I made the top part longer so that it is easier to hold. I had made the holes on the platform so that it is compatible with Hasbro Battleship pegs in case people don't want to print so many.

![Screenshot 2026-10-16 at 10.13.27 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/e5a1edec68ef98e1ac8418a26a793fee32b13361c5e62d6e19548f87b8176538.png)

### 2026-10-18 – Saturday October 17:

**3h**

Saturday October 17:

I started thinking about how I want the ship and peg containers to be. I thought of having two sides like the original battleship, but that looked way too long. I thought that I might be able to fit them all in one side, but I don't know yet.

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 at 9.53.29 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/16353c987d4058d5d086147c594aa2b589eb88a3a66c4ccc9b9b08b1101dbbdf.png)

I started thinking about how I wanted the ships to be. I didn't want it to be a copy of the original battleship, and I wanted to make some strange and interesting ideas. I came up with 5 things:

1-hole "raft"
2-hole "boat"
3-hole "pyramid"
4-hole "big-boat"
5-hole "carrier"

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 at 10.00.36 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/624f7894f4f34c7a30373b7508339b0e97796cc34f03f4488c5a66add28571eb.png)

The 1-hole and 3-hole ships were pretty simple and I got them done in a bit of time. The other ones though, took an extremely long time. For the 2-hole one, I spent lots of time figuring out how to make it fit well in the grid while not looking weird. For the 4-hole one, I first tried making the sides arcs. I felt a little unsure of whether they would fit, and when I took the dimensions, indeed it was too wide. In the image below, you can see where it should fit (highlighted tiles), and where it was going out of the boundary (orange dots)

![Screenshot 2026-10-17 at 10.07.06 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/907afcc2d4b2171539e0b8b159e97a8e880566a537321e205cfa0ac5bafe6d7f.png)

I did the fifth ship, and it was very annoying because whenever I tried to constrain the sides to be regular hexagons, they would suddenly go wacky and become a weird shape. I had to eventually linear pattern a hexagon and the small strips in between.

I eventually extruded the 5-ship and the 1-ship too.

### 2026-10-18 – I started checking over all of the ships. I realized that the pyramid ship sadly couldn't be a pyramid because I needed peg holes near the corners. Same goes for the other ships I was going to make fa

**1.9h**

I started checking over all of the ships. I realized that the pyramid ship sadly couldn't be a pyramid because I needed peg holes near the corners. Same goes for the other ships I was going to make fancy. I had to make them all flat.

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 at 8.45.47 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/252b5b08f4c2e7ef66468b4602ed8f23a565d8010e48930fb4e6fb7d3e6295cb.png)

I then had to make the hinge design for the platforms, and I watched a YouTube video to see a simple idea.

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 at 8.47.11 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/878632dcb10758cf8a4c55a534eccc5c55cc08733b329acbe1937f94f19f91d2.png)

I made a few sketches and extrudes to copy that onto the battleship, and it worked after I made the sides non-diagonal.

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 at 8.53.13 PM](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ALyNJTAoKKQxkBhHkvpPIPXU2JTDxn4z/14518e9ebb8e1738c10ff571e771ef8738c2a1c258a9762a02e557b055da9250.png)
